text:
AFK Gregorovic

​
Disclaimer
⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use #pvm-help if you cannot get it to work
​
Positioning
Positioning yourself in melee distance of where Gregorovic spawns is not necessary, but helps.
​
Magic AFK Method (58+ kph) 
Overview

















Mandatory AFK Requirements

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel:

⬥ Essence of Finality  / Amulet of Souls 
⬥ Masterwork magic armour 
⬥ Venomblood  / Irit incense sticks 
⬥ Weapon Poison +++ 
⬥ Cinderbane gloves 
⬥ Kwuarm incense sticks 
⬥ Scripture of Amascut 
⬥ Igneous Kal-Mej  / Igneous Kal-Zuk 
⬥ Exsanguinate 
⬥ Soul Split  + Torment 









​

Melee AFK Method (59+ kph) 
Overview

















Mandatory AFK Requirements

The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel:

⬥ Scrimshaw of vampyrism 
⬥ Vampyrism 
⬥ Ring of Retribution 
⬥ Brawler's Blood Necklace
⬥ Weapon Poison +++ 
⬥ Cinderbane gloves 
⬥ Kwuarm incense sticks 
⬥ Venomblood  / Irit incense sticks 
⬥ Soul Split  + Turmoil 
⬥ Igneous Kal-Ket  / Igneous Kal-Zuk 
⬥ Bonfire , Ogre flask (thermal) , Boon of Het if struggling to upkeep LP.

Necromancy AFK Method (58+ KPH) 
Overview

















Mandatory AFK Requirements

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥ Essence of Finality  or Amulet of Souls 
⬥ Scripture of Ful 
⬥ Cinderbane Gloves 
⬥ Igneous Kal-Mor  or Igneous Kal-Zuk 
Abilities
⬥ Conjure Undead Army 
    • Customised to conjure all spirits.
Other
⬥ Lesser Bone Shield  
⬥ Weapon poison +++ 
⬥ Pray Soul Split  + Sorrow 
    • Ruination  requires additional prayer restoration
⬥ Darkness  not active
⬥ Equilibrium aura 








⬥ Optionally, for increased safety: use Deathdealer robe bottom  with crystal shield 4  and absorbative 4

⬥ Bow of the Last Guardian  / Masterwork Bow 
⬥ Essence of Finality  / Amulet of Souls 
⬥ Igneous Kal-Xil  / Igneous Kal-Zuk 
⬥ Weapon Poison +++ 
⬥ Irit incense sticks  / Venomblood 
⬥ Cinderbane gloves 
⬥ Scripture of Amascut 
⬥ Ful Arrows 
⬥ Pray Soul Split  + Anguish 
    • Desolation  requires additional prayer restoration
⬥ Vampyrism aura
